steps: Installed WebKit/WASM: missing shared key short-circuits all; explicit matching event adoption; assumed completion ignores hidden invalid payload; Undo restores the original buffer; source remains unchanged.

Create from two adopted steps → Check/Apply → explicit passing replay; invalid JSON and Cancel preserve loaded result; changed payload stops at first mismatch; editing manual expectations produces a new passing case without changing the original path.

Scoped front-end transports only: export loaded/path Blob JSON differ as expected; real File.text import roundtrip is atomic; invalid import preserves the earlier result. OS pickers and download delivery are deliberately outside this result.

Fold retains raw JSON but revokes Check; Chinese/English/Japanese retain textarea identity, focus, selection and incomplete draft at the actual native minimum viewport. Synthetic composing Escape is ignored; real Escape cancels only the child editor and restores its opener.
limitations: Actual installed Linux Tauri/WebKit under tauri-driver/Xvfb, using the host-created disposable workspace and isolated XDG paths.
This tests the new-script form with a local two-state table; it cancels creation without saving or registering an author document.
Manual event/assumed-completion predictions are not runtime observations. This extension does not execute Godot, prove actual delivery, or test saved-script re-editing.
Inputs dispatch DOM input/change; buttons use WebDriver. Language refresh uses the installed i18n module; IME is a synthetic guard check, not an actual IME device.
Blob export and File input are scoped front-end transport checks. Native save/open dialogs and on-disk downloads are not claimed.
The production editor window has a 760px minimum width. This extension records the actual native narrow viewport; it does not claim a 390px native viewport.
